scope: Factors and central factor fibres of cyclic crossed products, under the stated modular, trace-scaling, continuous-decomposition and normal-disintegration foundations. Inner-return and trace-kernel lattices give the centre, finite matrix decomposition and exact subtype; eight solved exercises cover rational and irrational cases.
